title: SliceTensorGeneratorInterfaces
statement: Let C be a site with coefficient ring sheaf R and the stated module sheafification instances. Define extend(a) for a unital ring-sheaf map a:R→S to be the existing changeOfRingsOfUniverses, with the existing changeOfRingsHomOfUniverses on maps. TensorLift(R,A) is a natural isomorphism from ordinary right tensor by the underlying R-module of the algebra A to extend(A.hom) followed by scalar restriction. TensorLiftNormalized requires its forward map to send m tensor s to the original scalar-extension section s tensor m. On a slice C/V, LinearComparison(R,V,A) is a natural isomorphism between slice extension followed by scalar extension and slice scalar extension followed by extension at A.right. LinearNormalized sends s tensor [m]_a to [s tensor m]_a. These are the existing definitions extracted verbatim, with no assertion of existence and no new tensor or scalar extension. The ambient objects and generator formulas are those of [def-sf-localized-strict-tensor-comparison-data], ordinary tensor is [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and actual scalar extension is supplied by [lem-sp-scalar-extension-binary-coherence].

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03CY, 03EK and 0E8I; extraction of the scalar, tensor transport and strict tower steps of lem-sf-cbc-slice-tensor-generator-coherence.

proof.text: Reuse changeOfRingsOfUniverses and its map operation verbatim. Their identity and composition laws are scalarExtension_map_id and scalarExtension_map_comp. Define the two isomorphism types and their generator normalization predicates exactly as in the parent interface. No existence theorem is used and no new module or tensor object is constructed.
